'''Gormo and the Grackers''' was a [[Band/Legends|band]] that played in the [[Sunken Sarlacc cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It consisted of a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], and a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]].
